response.justification: Technically the candidate exceeds every requirement — 15+ years of fullstack work with TypeScript/Node, React, REST/GraphQL APIs, AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker, plus current AI/LLM tooling experience that matches the nice-to-haves. The mismatch is seniority: this is an entry-level individual contributor role, and a Staff/Senior engineer is likely to face compensation misalignment, limited growth appeal, and retention risk. Relational database depth is also less evident (MongoDB/MySQL rather than PostgreSQL), and there is no renewable-energy or construction-tech domain exposure. Berlin location fits the high on-site requirement, so a conversation about role scope and expectations would be worthwhile before ruling in or out.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node, React and AWS fullstack experience
Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD and LLM/AI tooling cover the nice-to-haves
Berlin-based, fits the high on-site presence requirement
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level IC position
PostgreSQL depth unclear; database work skews MongoDB/MySQL
No renewable energy or construction-tech domain background

key_factors.factor: Cloud, Kubernetes and LLM nice-to-haves covered
